model.insertion_probes: at most capacity; empty OR equal key accepts; no load-factor/resize guard
model.deletion_search: at most capacity, without empty-key early stop
model.backshift: at most capacity-1; stops at empty; move when ((cap-hole+j)&mask) <= ((cap-home+j)&mask)
model.invalid_key: Must not be an entity key; stored invalid key still denotes an empty bucket.
conditions: Unique real u32 keys distinct from invalid sentinel
Header points at writable capacity*8 bytes; constructor-initialized empty keys
No concurrent mutations during an operation
At most capacity distinct live keys
Ordinal validity for external component arrays is a separate invariant

invalid_key.note: Sentinel key is not an occupied/mappable entity; wrapper precondition.

examples.ordinal_zero_note: delete returns 0 for both absent key and a real key whose value was 0.

conclusions.full_table_existing_key_update: succeeds within 8 probes without new entry
conclusions.ninth_distinct_key: first attempted store is 4 bytes at address 0x4, RVA 0x172F7F2; no safe return
conclusions.deletion_return: deleted DWORD value, or 0 on not-found; zero is ambiguous
conclusions.allocation: Model does not change or prove actual game heap/array/storage sizes

limits: This is Python-model verification against captured instructions, not game execution.
Restricted interpreter is not a general x64 implementation or formal proof.
Exhaustive enumeration covers home-class sequences for multiplier2/cap8, not all process states.
Representative lookup is 60C890; other call sites and map types are not universally proved.
Sentinel global equality is modeled as a precondition; capture contains no writable runtime globals.
No live process query/read, new capture, game patch, mod install, or network test occurred.
